description: Contrastive long vowel: おばさん (aunt) vs おばあさん (grandmother)
Geminate contrast: きて vs きって (sokuon doubles the consonant mora)
notes: Glosses ai-assisted and deliberately terse; qualified review required before promotion. Pitch-accent pairs (e.g. ame contours) are intentionally NOT included: current TTS does not control lexical pitch accent, so synthesized audio would train a contrast it cannot produce.
